claude.request:
Today's international headlines:
- US too focused on Middle East and not pushing Russia hard enough, Zelensky tells BBC: Ukraine's president voices frustration with US and says it is "strange" Trump has described Vladimir Putin as a friend.
- Watch: Roofs torn off and streets under water as severe weather hits US: Hundreds of thousands have been affected by storms in the country as the Thanksgiving holiday weekend begins.
- New Zealand's ruling coalition falls short of parliamentary majority by one seat: The right-leaning ruling bloc led by the National Party has fallen short of the majority needed to govern.
- German boat dealer suspected of supplying Channel smuggling gangs, BBC finds: Nearly a third of crossings in early 2026 allegedly involved boats or engines from the German man's firm.
- Watch: BBC confronts German man suspected of supplying migrant gangs with small boats: Marvin Reuter is contesting extradition to France, where he could face smuggling, criminal conspiracy and involuntary manslaughter charges.
- Gérard Depardieu to stand trial for alleged rape of actress in 2018, court rules: A Paris appeals court rules Depardieu will go on trial for the alleged rape of Charlotte Arnould.
- Diesel tanker carrying up to 7,000 tonnes capsizes near Ibiza, killing one: The possible environmental damage is still being assessed by Spain's sea rescue service.
- Pregnant US inmate escapes in prison vehicle after medical appointment: Rebecca Taylor had been imprisoned in New Mexico for multiple theft and burglary charges.
- Two Italians killed in strike in Kuwait, as Iran denies responsibility: The pair were technicians for German company Rheinmetall, according to Italy's foreign ministry.
- Egyptian authorities arrest motorist over tanker crash that killed 31: Officials say the man confessed to travelling at speed and clipping the fuel truck as he was overtaking traffic.
- Hope for millions as cheaper HIV prevention jab reaches Africa: Lenacapavir, administered as an injection twice a year, is nearly 100% effective at preventing HIV infection.
- Myanmar refuses to comply with parts of ICJ genocide ruling: A landmark ruling by the International Court of Justice (ICJ) convicted Myanmar of genocide against its Rohingya minority.

image_provider.prompt: A fragmented world map dissolving into chaos: continents cracking and separating like continental drift in reverse, with shattered pieces suspended in turbulent water and storm clouds. Dark storm systems swirl over landmasses. In the center, a cracked mirror reflects fragments of different scenes—military equipment, boats, prison bars, medical syringes—all distorted and scattered. The color palette transitions from deep blues and grays to occasional harsh reds, suggesting both destruction and sparse hope. Style: apocalyptic realism with surreal, dreamlike dissolution of boundaries.
